name: Conquests, Book of
text: Conquests, Book of is a non-standard English title for Lebor Gabála Érenn, the Irish pseudo-history that records the successive occupations of Ireland. Scholars normally say Book of Invasions or keep the Irish form. See Lebor Gabála Érenn.
